variants.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the approved character identity and rendering reference: a highly detailed orange rune fox with a newly approved gentle friendly face. Produce ONE static full-body pose of this SAME exact fox. This request changes the body POSE, not the character design. Preserve its pointed long fox muzzle, naturally sized amber eyes and warm small closed-mouth smile, upright pointed ears, orange/white layered fur, highly detailed hand-painted highlights, dark precise contours, elaborate turquoise runic filigree on forehead/chest/shoulders/flank/tail, and large curved white-tipped bushy tail. Maintain original mature slender anatomy and head/body proportions. Do not make a baby, round-headed chibi, toy, simplified mascot or flat vector creature. Fur rendering must have the same richness as the reference. Every face remains friendly and cute without enormous eyes or goofy expressions. On a small mossy stone ground island consistent with the reference; genuine transparent background around it. Keep entire creature, all ears/tail/paws and ground fully inside the square image with 8% clear padding. One fox, no lettering, numerals, UI frames, labels, motion streaks or multiple frames. Static character concept only, no animation or spritesheet. Match the existing fantasy game's visual system. POSE: Curious greeting. Stand naturally on all four paws with the body at a left-facing three-quarter angle, the head gently tilted about 12 degrees towards the viewer, one ear attentive and the other slightly relaxed. The tail sweeps comfortably behind to the right with a soft lifted tip, rather than recreating the reference's vertical tail. Gentle interested eye contact. Alert, welcoming, light and alive; do not raise the same forepaw as the reference.
